name: Roland MC-808
description: Roland MC-808 sampling groovebox: the current pattern's part settings (effects, and the mixer of all sixteen parts), Part 1's temporary patch and rhythm set, the arpeggio style and the chord form, with the setup and system blocks, from the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: MC-808 MIDI Implementation
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from MC-808_MI.pdf (sha256 21b4c105e6b992040ee11113ab30fc5113f87329589c9342d854f222dd7ed901). Model ID 00 00 14, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Part Info (10 00 00 00) is the current pattern's part settings: its effects and each part's mixer (Patch Bank Select/Program Number, level, pan, tune, sends, output). Its blocks are groups "Part Info · …" and "Part n · Mixer".

Part 1's temporary patch is at 11 00 00 00 (common, tone mix table at 11 00 10 00, tones 1-4 at 11 00 20 00 … 11 00 26 00) and its rhythm set at 11 10 00 00 (common, then key 59 at 11 10 5C 00 … key 74 at 11 10 7A 00). The Rhythm offset table prints only keys 59-74; their offsets follow the 88-key layout of Roland's other synths (key 21 would be 00 10 00); the manual prints nothing at 00 10 00 … 00 5A 00.
Rows marked <*> are ignored when the instrument receives them (p7); Patch Common 00 0D, Tone Type<*>, is one, and is not laid out.

The Temporary Arpeggio (15 00 00 00) and Temporary Chord (18 00 00 00) are the arpeggio style and chord form being edited; they are read at startup, last, so that if the instrument does not answer for them nothing else is lost.
Model ID 00 00 14, as the address map heading ("MC-808 (ModelID = 00H 00H 14H)", p7), the sentence and the RQ1 and DT1 byte tables (p4, p5) and the worked examples (p17) all print it.

Part Info Common (10 00 00 00, p8): Voice Reserve 1-16 are each printed with <*>, ignored when the MC-808 receives them, so the block is not laid out. The MC-909 prints the same sixteen rows without the mark.

Presets list Patches (Bank Select MSB 81: User A-H 0-7, Card A-H 32-39), Rhythms (MSB 82: User A-B 0-1, Card A-B 32-33) and Sample Patches (MSB 64 User 0-15, MSB 65 Card 0-54), p1, recalled on the profile's channel. The table names the bank at MSB 81 LSB 39 "User Patch H"; it closes the Card Patch run (Card Patch A 32, B 33, …), so it is listed here as Card Patch H.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.patch, part1.patch.tmt, part1.patch.tone1, part1.patch.tone2, part1.patch.tone3, part1.patch.tone4, part1.rhythm, part1.rhythm.key59, part1.rhythm.key60, part1.rhythm.key61, part1.rhythm.key62, part1.rhythm.key63, part1.rhythm.key64, part1.rhythm.key65, part1.rhythm.key66, part1.rhythm.key67, part1.rhythm.key68, part1.rhythm.key69, part1.rhythm.key70, part1.rhythm.key71, part1.rhythm.key72, part1.rhythm.key73, part1.rhythm.key74.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel transmits (Data Transmission, p4-6, and the Received/Transmitted Data List, p18) is not mapped yet
coverage.parts: the Part Info part mixer for all sixteen parts; the temporary patch and rhythm set for Part 1 only. Parts 2-16's are not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Part n) is at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 20 00 00 (11 20 00 00, 11 40 00 00, 11 60 00 00, 12 00 00 00 … 14 60 00 00), with its patch at +00 00 00 and its rhythm set at +10 00 00
coverage.toneTypes: a part plays a patch or a rhythm set; Part 1's are both laid out (patch at 11 00 00 00, rhythm set at 11 10 00 00) and neither is read at startup. The manual says (p4) that a request it cannot answer gets no reply, and the engine's startup read stops at the first request that is not answered
coverage.rhythmKeys: complete as printed: the manual's Rhythm offset table lists keys 59-74 (16 tones), at 11 10 5C 00 … 11 10 7A 00 for Part 1
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.notModelled: patterns, songs and sample data (not in the address map: no RQ1/DT1 reaches them); the "Quick SysEx" map printed after the main one (model ID 5D, two-byte addresses and two-byte data: patch, rhythm and sequencer parameters per part), which a profile with one model ID cannot carry
coverage.voiceReserve: not laid out: every row of Part Info Common (10 00 00 00, Voice Reserve 1-16, p8) is marked <*>, ignored when received
